about: THE WAR MAP's data (docs/war_map_v1.md): one file for every skin (the King's parchment now; the Clockmaker's brass map and the Naturalist's specimen chart read the same (docs/war_map_act2.md)). Points are [lon, lat]; outlines are flat [lon, lat, lon, lat, ...]. Holders: empire (the plain purple of the empire), crown, contested, machine, brood, unrest, unknown (blank). Rules run in order, a later one wins. EVERY TEXT IS A PLACEHOLDER.
title: THE WAR MAP

marks.label: The old mine: the crates of 2767
The honest masters, at the coast
The Queen: where nobody has been

pins.title: The Gold of Vila Rica
pins.about: Tomasz, a missionary in Brazil now, and the garrison stop the Free Assembly's rising in the gold town.

pins.title: The City of Gears
pins.about: The guild founds a free city over an old mine; the valley below fears it from the first day.

pins.title: The Mission of São Rafael
pins.about: The swarm comes out of the flooded forest at Tomasz's mission: bring the people to the river fort.

pins.title: The Queen
pins.about: The flood comes to Lindqvist's island; in the pens the strongest Mother grows into a Queen.

pins.title: The Council of Gears
pins.about: The city's machines begin to vote through the masters who wind them. Hollweg at the great spring.

pins.title: Down the Rivers
pins.about: Valadares holds the Barra against the swarm in the floods and brings the people of Nazaré out.

pins.title: Between Two Fires
pins.about: The army of Brazil marches to the fort at the crossroads; both fires find it. The Crown chooses which first.

pins.title: The Jungle Front
pins.about: The army's jungle column breaks the swarm's nests on the river, Valadares leading it.

pins.title: The Siege of Concórdia
pins.about: The army's southern column lays siege to the city of gears, Father Ferrer as Rome's witness.

pins.title: The Hold
pins.about: Optional. Eggs found in a Brazilian ship's hold at Luanda: hunt what hatched before the tide takes it.

pins.title: The Mining Machines
pins.about: Optional. Concórdia's mining machines wake in the Viceroy's arsenal at Goa, Father Ferrer arriving.

rules.ledger: Virginia held: Fairleigh broke the Free Assembly at the fort's gate.
The Hollins families were saved: a loyal village in Virginia.
The families were left behind: the interior is uneasy.
Virginia rose: the Free Assembly holds the fort.
Nuremberg is lost: the machine holds Franconia.
A loyal quarter still holds out inside Nuremberg.
Townsfolk who reached Fürth from Nuremberg: %s.
The bells were rung: the Crown trusts the guild.
The bells stayed quiet: a Crown commissary watches the guild.
Hollweg carried his drawings out of the west gate.
Hollweg held the west gate for the people and left his drawings.
Jakob was lost in Nuremberg.
The Fürth line held, strong.
The Fürth line held, but thin.
Fürth fell to the machine.
The Academy's station on the Rio Negro burned. Something came down from the mountain to the north.
The station's people who reached Nazaré: %s.
The clutch was saved and carried downriver.
The clutch was burned.
Lieutenant Teles was never told: the station stayed the Academy's secret.
Valadares drew the plateau for the Crown: the creatures' mountain is on the map.
Valadares withheld his map: the plateau stays blank.
Few of the mapmaker's party came down alive.
The whole of the mapmaker's party came down alive.
The plateau kept its secret: the mapmaker never came down.
Lyon's presses were found: the city is calm.
Lyon's presses were found, but the city is sullen.
Lyon rose: the Free Assembly's flags on the Terreaux.
The broken automata were melted down.
The broken automata were kept for study.
The machine's red spreads east of Nuremberg.
Cages brought down to the river: %s.
Every cage came down to the Barra: the Academy has its breeding stock.
Few of the Academy's cages reached the river.
The creatures broke the Academy's cages on the mountain.
Paris was taken back from the barricades.
Paris held behind its barricades: the Free Assembly's flags on the Hôtel de Ville.
Varenne was spared and sent into exile.
Varenne was executed: risings flare in the provinces.
The Council of Rome gave its verdict.
Rome burned: few of its quarters stood.
Rome burned in part: some of its quarters stood.
Every quarter of Rome stood through the night of fire.
Saved on the steps of Saint Peter's: %s.
Hollweg and Lindqvist defied the verdict and left Rome.
The creatures crossed the Tiber into Saint Peter's Square.
The machines crossed the Tiber into Saint Peter's Square.
The guild left Fürth by night and went down the Main to the sea: it has left the Crown.
Families who left Fürth with the guild: %s.
Hollweg carried the Perpetual's drawings away.
The Perpetual's drawings are in the Crown's hands.
Jakob stayed at Fürth with the Crown.
Hollweg taken alive on the road to the Main: not how it went.
Lindqvist breeds the specimens on an island below Óbidos, against Rome's verdict.
The commission searched the island and found nothing of what Lindqvist keeps.
The commission found some of Lindqvist's stock and burned it; the rest was never found.
The commission found most of Lindqvist's stock and burned the pens.
Young never found on the island: %s.
A Storm Sire hatched on the island: the first bred by a man.
Valadares' commission destroyed half of Lindqvist's stock.
The rising of the mines was broken at Vila Rica on the day of the tax.
The clergy went house to house before the signal: Vila Rica is quiet.
Vila Rica is quiet only under the bayonet: the mines are restless.
All of the Foundry House's gold reached the coast.
Some of the Foundry House's gold reached the coast; the gorge took the rest.
Little of the Foundry House's gold reached the coast.
The conspirators' leader was taken alive.
The conspirators' leader escaped south, to the city of gears.
The conspiracy took the Foundry House: not how it went.
Hollweg founded Concórdia on the southern highlands: a city that governs itself.
Varenne's ship of exile ended at Concórdia: he speaks for the city now.
The valley's captain parleyed with Hollweg on the road.
The valley fought the city from its first day.
In the mine Hollweg opened the two crates of 2767.
The valley burned the city's first quarter: not how it went.
Tomasz left the fields standing for the people's return: the swarm fed on them.
The fields and the granary of São Rafael were burned: the swarm found nothing to eat.
Most of São Rafael's people reached the river fort.
Some of São Rafael's people reached the river fort.
Few of São Rafael's people reached the river fort.
The swarm broke the church of São Rafael before the people reached the fort.
The fazenda fell in a night of flood. In its pens the strongest Mother grew into a Queen, and every bred creature turned to it.
Nearly all of the bred creatures went to the Queen.
Some of the bred creatures went to the Queen.
Few of the bred creatures went to the Queen: Lindqvist burned the rest.
Pieter did not reach the canoes.
The great spring was left running: the city ran on, and Hollweg called it saved.
Hollweg stopped the great spring: the city is dead brass; the honest masters went to the coast.
Most of the honest masters stood with Hollweg.
Some of the honest masters stood with Hollweg.
Few of the honest masters stood with Hollweg.
The machine meshed the council hall before dawn.
The swarm came down the rivers in the floods; the towns above the Barra are empty.
Valadares held the Barra, every quarter standing.
Valadares held the bluff, but the Barra's lower town burned.
The lure book was burned, as Rome ordered.
The lure book was used once, to draw the great wave into the flooded forest.
All of Nazaré was brought down the river.
Some of Nazaré was brought down the river.
Few of Nazaré's people were brought down the river.
The swarm took the Barra's bluff and its guns: not how it went.
The army of Brazil relieved the fort at the crossroads of the São Francisco.
Ruggieri chose the swarm first: the army went up the rivers.
Ruggieri chose the city first: the army went south to the highlands.
Most of the road's villages came into the fort.
Some of the road's villages came into the fort.
Few of the road's villages came into the fort.
The army's scouts saw it from the road: Concórdia is the machine's.

rules.clock: Waits: the army is in the north, and the city grows while it waits.
Waits: the army is in the south, and the swarm spreads while it waits.

rules.ledger: The swarm's nests on the river were broken in time: the river towns hold.
The nests were broken too late: the lower river is the swarm's.
The swarm held the river till the dry season.
The great spring's tower was blown from the old mine: the city is crippled and besieged.
The army holds the road, but the city stands whole behind its walls.
Jakob fell before the walls of Concórdia.
The city broke the siege's batteries.
Every egg in the hold at Luanda was found and burned.
Some of the eggs at Luanda were carried off by the tide: the first of the Brood in Africa.
The mining machines at Goa were smashed in the Viceroy's arsenal.
Some of the mining machines were shipped on from Goa: the first seed in Asia.
